footnote_text: Represents restricted common shares of Securitize Corp. ("Issuer", and such shares, "Common Shares") that may become earned and delivered pursuant to the earnout provided for in that certain business combination agreement, dated as of October 27, 2025, by and between Issuer, Securitize, Inc. ("Securitize"), Cantor Equity Partners II, Inc. and certain other parties thereto (the "Business Combination Agreement" and such restricted Common Shares, the "Earnout Shares") in respect of the reporting person's options to acquire Common Shares that were exchanged for options to acquire shares of common stock of Securitize ("Securitize Common Shares") in connection with the mergers (the "Mergers") contemplated by the Business Combination Agreement. || The Mergers were consummated on July 1, 2026. The Earnout Shares will generally be earned one-third on the date that the 20-day volume-weighted average price per Common Share attains $15.00, $20.00 and $25.00 over a 30-trading day period during the period beginning 90-days after the closing of the Mergers and ending on July 1, 2031.

Each Restricted Stock Unit ("RSU") represents a contingent right to receive one Common Share. One hundred percent (100%) of the RSUs shall become vested on July 1, 2027, subject to the reporting person's continued service with the Issuer through July 1, 2027.
